title: Good but mine arrived with some dirt inside the glass.
text: Good but mine arrived with some dirt inside the glass.. I don't usually mind such things because well who cares and it's not like anyone will see it but for such a random buy I didn't think I would get a "defective" item you know? I noticed that the glass had a tiny black speck right in the middle at first I thought it was dirty so I tried to clean it but then I realized it was inside the actual glass, mind you it's not a big deal but I also didn't care much for how it looked overall, the edges were sharper than I expected which in my opinion makes it feel cheap and it just didn't look as nice as I expected it to, I mean it's not a big deal for what I wanted but it doesn't make me want to buy this again either. Also this is totally on me but I thought it was a lot smaller in size it's pretty big for what I imagined it'd be, I guess if you want it to place food on it it's fine probably. It does look like exactly as described though and it is what it is so I can't really complain about the product other than the small speck I saw.
